nvitk.segmentation.eicab.runner¶

Local eICAB inference via singularity run and optional output pruning.

nvitk.segmentation.eicab.runner.metric_scratch_cleanup_shell(root: str | None = None) → str¶

Shell snippet: remove only this job’s nvitk_eicab_<JOB_ID> dir.

Guards: - rebuilds the path from scratch root + JOB_ID (no glob); - requires basename prefix nvitk_eicab_; - refuses to delete the scratch root itself.

nvitk.segmentation.eicab.runner.run_eicab(input_nii: str | pathlib.Path, output_dir: str | pathlib.Path, *, resolution: float = 0.625, simple_segmentation: bool = False, attention: bool = False, device: str = 'cpu', container: str | pathlib.Path, tmp_dir: str | pathlib.Path, keep_aux_outputs: bool = False, vasculature_host_path: str | pathlib.Path | None = None, check: bool = True, capture_output: bool = True) → subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]¶

Run eICAB via singularity run (same contract as legacy BioImaging).

vasculature_host_path should be the host directory bind-mounted to /programs/Neuro/vasculature2 (see run_eicab_inference.sh). When omitted and the path does not exist, the vasculature bind is skipped (only sensible for debugging).
